templates.intent: Explicit nullable result handling with a typed boundary.

files.main.php:
<?php

// Stable nullable boundary.
function maybe_name(int $id): ?string {
	if ($id === 1) {
		return "Alex";
	}

	return null;
}

// Explicit null handling.
$name = maybe_name(2);
if ($name === null) {
	echo "missing\n";
}

templates.intent: Scenario skeleton for typed accumulation over a foreach loop.

files.main.php:
<?php

// Stable typed aggregation.
function sum_all(array $items): int {
	$total = 0;
	foreach ($items as $item) {
		$total = $total + $item;
	}

	return $total;
}

// Deterministic aggregate output.
echo sum_all([1, 2, 3, 4]), "\n";
